qa: App Fusion is possible with the following combinations. ●[Dokamon] with [Perorimon] link card ●[Dokamon] with [Musclemon] link card ●[Perorimon] with [Dokamon] link card ●[Perorimon] with [Musclemon] link card ●[Musclemon] with [Dokamon] link card ●[Musclemon] with [Perorimon] link card
extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [App Fusion] [Dokamon] & [Perorimon] & [Musclemon] : Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Dokamon] & [Perorimon] & [Musclemon] : Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may link 1 level 3 Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, it can't be deleted in battle until your opponent's turn ends.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] This Digimon can't be deleted in battle until your opponent's turn ends.
